Class MenuDao

java.lang.Object
sakaboba.dao.MenuDao
public class MenuDao extends Object
Menu item persistence. Each operation opens and closes its own connection.

      private static int createRecipe(Connection connection, String name) throws SQLException
      Each menu item has its own recipe row. A new size of an existing drink copies that drink's preparation time; a brand-new drink starts at the usual 5 minutes.
